snippet.title: Hazard Levels - Teaser Trailer
snippet.description:
Hazard Levels is a brand new co-op from the team behind Sker Ritual. The deeper the rift, the stranger it gets. Just make it back before last orders.

Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1374680/Hazard_Levels/
Join us on Discord: https://discord.gg/asKp8Rg8mc

Join us on this journey over on the Hazard Levels Discord. Keep up to date with the latest game news, feedback your thoughts straight to the devs and be a part of the upcoming, exclusive closed BETA.
